questions.q: What does Holiday say a blog becomes when it aims to earn money?
questions.why: He states a blog is a business whenever it seeks profit.

questions.q: Which ad platform does the book cite for paying per impression?
questions.why: The example given is Google AdSense paying per banner view.

questions.q: Why do many blogs publish low‑quality content, according to the author?
questions.why: He notes blogs prioritize buzz over accuracy to get page views.

questions.q: What historical practice does the book compare modern blog shaming to?
questions.why: He likens blog‑driven shaming to 21st‑century public witch hunts.

questions.q: What type of headline exemplifies the click‑bait style described?
a: "5 Pics That Will Make You Even Angrier At Your Step Mother"
questions.why: He cites such sensational headlines as typical click‑bait.
